# EveryWoman

> Strength training and movement for women navigating endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum recovery, and hormonal transitions.

Madeleine Stockton founded EveryWoman to coach strength training and movement for women living with endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum symptoms, and hormonal transitions.

## Pages

- [EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/): Strength training and movement for women navigating endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum recovery, and hormonal transitions.
- [About · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/about/): Madeleine Stockton founded EveryWoman, strength training and movement for women navigating endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum recovery, and hormonal transitions.
- [Coaching Services · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/services/): Strength training built for your body, your health, and your life.
- [Contact · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/contact/): Reach Madeleine Stockton by email, or find EveryWoman on Substack, Instagram, and TikTok.
- [Posts · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/posts/): Essays, Instagram, and TikTok from EveryWoman.

- [From a Hospital Bed to the Weight Room](https://everywoman.io/posts/from-a-hospital-bed-to-the-weight/): What movement really looks like after surgery.
